reviews.summary: The refreshed Letter card is honest (free as a short note, three paragraphs and photos with "Make it special"), but the "His phone at midnight" item still said a digital gift arrives with your photos, which contradicts it. Asked to say photos and timing come with a premium unlock or "Make it special".

Verified the free note (free-tier.ts, 500 characters; the sample letter is 604 EN / 644 ES characters, so "three full paragraphs" need "Make it special"), the Letter, Birthday Cinema and Pop-up Card against their manifests, and every link. Fixes: the midnight item in both languages (photos are not free; the time picker offers quarter hours, not "to the minute"), and the Spanish card's "y tus fotos cayendo como polaroids" aside, which read as a calque.

The method, the year-he's-had lines and the round-number letter beat page one's 40-to-200-line lists. Fixes: a description short enough not to be cut, "wishes" in the title ("birthday wishes for husband" 9,900 a month, KD 3, and every top-10 title says it), and the long-distance intent of result 2 named in the away item with a line to send.

applied: EN midnight item: "it can open at midnight in his time zone; your photos and the timing come with a premium template or with \"Make it special\""; ES to match.
ES Letter card: "La carta entera, con sus tres párrafos y tus fotos cayendo como polaroids, viene con «Hazlo especial», pagada una vez".
EN title "Birthday messages for your husband: 35 wishes and a letter".
EN description "Birthday messages and wishes for your husband: lines for the year he's had, romantic, funny and short ones, and a letter for 40, 50 or 60."

Away item now "If he's away, or you're long distance" / "Si está fuera, o vivís a distancia", with a second line in each language ("Happy birthday from a long way away. I'm counting the days until I can say it to your face.").
rejected: Search polish (wishes before the table, "heartfelt" in a heading, a heart-touching FAQ, a "(one line)" heading): polish, and this run's change is the free-tier correction.

reviews.summary: The midnight item no longer implies a free gift carries photos, and the Letter card is plain about what's free; with the three-part table, the year-he's-had lines and the where-to-put-it list it is the page to send a friend instead of a 200-line list. Polish: a smoother wording of the midnight item.

All three round-1 fixes made correctly; scheduling and photos checked against extras.tsx, free-tier.ts and products.ts; "35 wishes" holds (34 list lines plus the kids' line, the same in Spanish); the new away lines are natural in both languages; every link resolves. Polish: «con un solo pago» for the card, "y una carta" in the Spanish title, and a Spanish description to match the shortened English.

Page one is undifferentiated lists of 40 to 200 lines; this post answers the same search with a method, lines matched to the year he's had and to how he takes attention, a worked 40th letter, and the long-distance and midnight cases. All round-1 fixes confirmed. Polish: two or three more romantic lines if good ones turn up.

rejected: Round-2 polish (the midnight item's wording, «con un solo pago», the Spanish title and description): final-round polish goes in the record, not the post (RUBRIC.md, the loop, step 4).
